blocks.text: LUCENA CITY — The weather bureau warned residents in seven areas across Cavite, Laguna, Batangas, and Quezon to take extra precautions against high heat index levels on Wednesday despite the possibility of rain. Philippine Atmospheric, Geophysical and Astronomical Services Administration (Pagasa) projected a heat index of 39 degrees Celsius in Sangley Point, Cavite City, and the island municipality of Alabat.in Quezon. Tanauan City in Batangas, Mulanay town in Quezon, and the City of Los Baños in Laguna are expected to record a heat index of 37 degrees.
